# Peekaboot

> Peekaboot is a Spring Boot starter that shows a running application's traces, logs, failures, routes and metrics on a dashboard at /peekaboot, and serves the same data as JSON under /peekaboot/api.

An agent debugging an application that runs Peekaboot starts with `GET /peekaboot/api` on that application. It lists every endpoint and links the OpenAPI 3.1 document at `/peekaboot/api/openapi.json`. Where Peekaboot's guard is armed, send HTTP Basic credentials. A value that reads `******` is masked.

## Docs

- [Agents](https://www.peekaboot.org/docs/agents/): authentication, masked values, and recipes for debugging a 500, finding slow or failing routes, reading health over time and searching logs
- [peekaboot skill](https://github.com/peekaboot-org/peekaboot-skills): the recipes as an agent skill, with install commands for Claude Code and Codex, and a copy step for other agents
- [HTTP API](https://www.peekaboot.org/docs/api/): every endpoint, parameter, field and error
- [Traces](https://www.peekaboot.org/docs/traces/): what a trace holds, its outcome, issues and buckets
- [Insights](https://www.peekaboot.org/docs/insights/): the metric history and the problems the API names
- [Security](https://www.peekaboot.org/docs/security/): what Peekaboot exposes, masking and the guard
- [Configuration](https://www.peekaboot.org/docs/configuration/): every property

## Optional

- [Quick start](https://www.peekaboot.org/docs/quick-start/)
- [Troubleshooting](https://www.peekaboot.org/docs/troubleshooting/)
